task_instance: Secure Linktree: produce a redacted security-baseline control matrix for a sample Workspace (main) from sanitized input fixtures (access policy, approved-destination list, integration/audience-export inventory, retention rules, prior incidents), covering the skill's full Output contract and emitting the documented operator receipt.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and its references map. Created sanitized input fixtures a user would supply in fixtures/ (access-policy.md with 4 users, destinations.csv with 12 destinations, integrations.md with 2 integrations + 2 exports, incidents.md). Inspected them with grep/awk per the skill's Read/Glob/Grep discipline: computed users=4, mfa=3/4 (editor-04 off), 11/12 destinations approved, one http-downgrade destination, one UNKNOWN-owner destination with unexpected redirect, one export with no retention rule, one open incident. Produced the deliverable baseline/control-matrix.md containing all eight required Output sections (asset inventory; access & MFA state; destination findings; integration & data-flow findings; exceptions with named remediation owners; prior incidents; evidence dates; risk decision) plus the skill's documented operator-receipt line 'workspace=main; users=4; mfa=3/4; unknown-admins=0; destinations=11-approved/1-quarantined; exports=1-controlled/1-halted; exceptions=4; risk=not-accepted'. Verified via find and grep that the file exists, the receipt line is present, and all eight sections are present. The skill's core intent (a reproducible, redacted security baseline from repository/fixture inspection with Write) is a documentation/design-only deliverable achievable with shell and file tools; no live Linktree account, WebFetch, credentials, or MCP/connector access was needed for the chosen minimal instance (those paths are explicitly the skill's approval-gated live-work options and were not exercised). All work done inside the work directory; no external writes.
